Package dayplanner

Class RasParser

java.lang.Object
dayplanner.RasParser
public final class RasParser extends Object

This class contains methods that parse and write RAS (Readable Activity Serial) activity records. RAS is the custom text format that allows data to be persisted to disk.

All methods of this class are static, so it is not necessary to instantiate this class.

RAS records are comma-delimited and wrapped in angle brackets. Commas in field values are not escaped. Commas and angle brackets are sanitized/desanitized so they can be used in Activity fields.

For the full RAS specification, read the README.md documentation.

    • parse

      public static Activity parse(String ras) throws RasException

      Parses one RAS record and creates its corresponding activity.

      Unknown type names produce a plain Activity, preserving the format's existing fallback behavior.

      Parameters:
      ras - Serialized activity record.
      Returns:
      The activity represented by the record.
      Throws:
      RasException - when RAS input is invalid.

      public static String[] fields(String ras) throws RasException
      Returns the fields inside one RAS record. Missing fields are retained as empty strings so the activity class can apply its existing defaults.

      The record fields, including the activity type at index zero.
